NEH 7:65.KJV: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.

NEH 7:66.KJV: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
NEH 7:66.BHSA: כָּל־הַקָּהָ֖ל כְּאֶחָ֑ד אַרְבַּ֣ע רִבֹּ֔וא אַלְפַּ֖יִם שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאֹ֥ות וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃
